why: No major reviewer or authority appears; the only named publications are off-target (Axios on V2G, SlashGear on 12V batteries). Four of the twelve are Anker's own blogs pushing the C2000/F3800, one is a UDPOWER store, one is a 404, two are affiliate explainers. Only whichwatts gives a direct answer with named stations and miles-of-range estimates, and it is untested with no prices. A page that measures real added range per station on a couple of common EVs, covers the ground-bonding and continuous-output gotchas, and gives a priced pick would be the clear best source.
